title: Eyes of the Fourth Dimension
next_chapter_hook: As the outline of the fourth possibility gradually became clear, Chen Ji realized the true choice had just begun—and the Heavenly Eye's gaze had already locked onto him.

text.content: That beyond-dimensional gaze pierced his brow center like an ice spike, yet Chen Ji laughed. Calmly, mockingly—the Heavenly Eye wanted to reassess him? Fine, let this heaven see for itself what kind of board the chess piece it handpicked could overturn.

The Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled in his Mental Sea, golden runes churning like boiling water. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice sharply rose: "Fourth-dimensional perception—success! Lad, you won the gamble!" Chen Ji felt something deep in his eyeballs shatter, followed by endless light pouring in.

The world before his eyes transformed completely. No longer the three-dimensional shells and outlines, but countless intertwining threads of fate—each one leading to a possible future. Past, present, future simultaneously spread before his vision, like an unfolded chess manual, every killing move clearly visible.

dialogue.content: (In his pupils reflected the interweaving of fate's net, Chen Ji slowly spoke, voice carrying a tremor, not of fear, but of barely contained excitement) So this is... the Eyes of the Fourth Dimension?

(Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice echoed in the Mental Sea, with an incredulous tremor) For a millennium... no one has been able to glimpse the fourth possibility at this realm! Chen Xuan back then only extrapolated to the third! Lad, what kind of monster are you?

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer. His gaze pierced through the intricate web of fate before him, landing on the deepest, hazy yet massive silhouette—the Heavenly Eye. That wasn't a physical eye, but a will transcending personality, a law enveloping the entire heaven and earth.

dialogue.content: (A cold, emotionless voice rang directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, as if pouring down from the Nine Heavens) "Interesting. An ant dares to glimpse my true form."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a tremendous pressure envelop his entire body, as if heaven and earth were compressing his existence. The three-dimensional world around him began to distort and collapse—the Heavenly Eye was crushing him with dimension itself. An ordinary person would have been crushed to dust under such pressure.

dialogue.content: (Pressed until his bones creaked, Chen Ji's lips curved into a mocking arc, blood trickling from his eye corners) Is this all? I thought the Heavenly Eye would be more impressive—turns out it only knows how to press people with dimensions?

text.content: The pressure suddenly stalled, as if the Heavenly Eye hadn't expected an ant to dare backtalk. In that fleeting moment, Chen Ji's Eyes of the Fourth Dimension caught a fissure—a fourth possibility never before shown in the web of fate was slowly emerging from the crack.

choice.prompt: The essence of the fourth possibility had been revealed—a fusion of breaking shackles and replacing Heavenly Dao. Chen Ji gazed at that fissure, an unprecedented impulse surging in his heart.

choices.description: Break the shackles, shake off Heavenly Dao's control, be no one's chess piece. The cost is losing the source of power from the Tianji Record, becoming a variable independent of fate.
choices.visible_cost: Losing Core Functions of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Free Will Independent of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Facing Unknown Consequences After Losing the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji extended his hand, penetrating that fissure. The moment he touched the shackles, he sensed the wails of countless generations of prophets—they were bound, exploited, drained, then discarded like refuse. "I have never been anyone's chess piece." His voice was terrifyingly calm.

Crack—

The fissure suddenly widened, the shackles snapped with a sound. Countless imprisoned threads of fate scattered like wild horses breaking free, the Heavenly Eye's pressure vanished instantly. And in Chen Ji's eyes, the outline of that fourth possibility appeared completely for the first time.

choices.description: Replace Heavenly Dao, become the new supreme will. The cost is the obliteration of humanity, replacing the human heart with a heavenly heart—from now on, no more Chen Ji, only the new Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Absolute Power Surpassing Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: After Replacing Heavenly Dao, Will I Still Be Myself?

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that immense power of the Heavenly Dao, his eyes burning with fervent desire. Replace it—transform this cowardly vessel into a true deity. "This world only needs one will." His voice began to reverberate like heavenly thunder.

His consciousness transformed into a blade, ruthlessly piercing into the core of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. That transcendent will quivered violently, seemingly unprepared for an ant to dare rebel against a god. Chen Ji felt power surge into his body like a flood, expanding to the point of nearly rupturing his soul.

choices.description: Breaking free while merging with the Heavenly Dao means not replacement but transcendence. The price is eternal entanglement with the Heavenly Dao's Eye, becoming a contradictory existence of both binding and freedom.
choices.visible_cost: Establish a permanent bond with the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.visible_reward: Gain the possibility of balancing Heaven's Decree and freedom
choices.risk_hint: The state after merging is completely unknown

text.content: Chen Ji did not strike at the Heavenly Dao's Eye, nor did he break free from his chains. He did something not even Mo Xiansheng anticipated—he extended his hand and clasped that will. "Since you and I can coexist within this realm," his voice was calm, "why not try coexisting?"

The Heavenly Dao's Eye fell silent. That transcendent will displayed a emotion resembling confusion for the first time. It examined Chen Ji as if asking: You dare not fear me? Chen Ji responded with a meaningful smile—fear? He didn't even fear death, so how could he fear a mere will?

The three choices intertwined within the four-dimensional space, finally merging into a brand-new light—that being the true form of the fourth possibility. It was neither simple breaking free nor straightforward replacement, but a perfect balance of breaking and merging.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded once more, this time carrying unprecedented solemnity: "I understand now... why Chen Xuan didn't choose this path. Because he never truly possessed the four-dimensional eye. And you, young one—you are the first."

dialogue.content: (The Heavenly Dao's Eye's will fluctuated more intensely, that cold voice carrying a rare hint of emotion) "Interesting... over a thousand years, the first ant to dare sit across from me."
(Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his eye, a faint smile playing at his lips) Ant? Senior Heavenly Dao, we are both in this four-dimensional rift now. Who's to say which of us is the ant?

text.content: In the Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly unfurled, golden runes forming a path leading into the unknown depths. Chen Ji saw Chen Nian's figure flickering at the end of the path—she was bound by countless Heavenly Fate chains, her lips moving as if speaking.

dialogue.content: (His pupils constricted sharply, Chen Ji's voice dropping low) Nian Nian...

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye continued examining Chen Ji while Chen Nian's figure appeared faintly in the depths of fate. Chen Ji had to respond.

choices.description: Engage the Heavenly Dao's Eye as an equal, neither showing weakness nor provocation, displaying the demeanor of a chess player.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Heavenly Dao's Eye's temporary recognition
choices.risk_hint: May be regarded as a threat and suppressed

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing down all surging emotions. His gaze became deep and profound once more, his voice steady without a trace of fluctuation: "Since Senior Heavenly Dao has observed me for so long, surely you have reached a conclusion. The junior awaits respectfully."

choices.description: Directly confront the Heavenly Dao's Eye about Chen Nian, demanding an explanation. Display protective nature.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.visible_reward: May obtain clues about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May incur direct suppression from the Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji's voice turned ice-cold: 'Since you're here, Senior, you might as well tell me—where have you imprisoned my sister, Chen Nian?' In this moment, he was no longer the waste disciple, but a madman who would overturn the heavens for his kin.

choices.description: Feigning weakness while secretly probing the limits of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, buying time for subsequent schemes.
choices.risk_hint: May Be Seen Through by the Heavenly Dao's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, assuming a modest posture: 'This junior is merely a frog in a well, if there was any offense, I hope the Senior will forgive. It's just this Four-Dimensional Eye... this junior truly wants to understand what it actually is.' As he spoke, his divine consciousness subtly extended, probing the boundaries of destiny.

The Four-Dimensional Eye operated frantically, countless visions flickering before Chen Ji's eyes like a kaleidoscope. He saw Chen Nian trapped on a pitch-black altar, surrounded by countless rune chains—the Heavenly Fate Altar of the Holy Sect. And the other end of those chains was actually connected to the Heavenly Dao's Eye itself.

dialogue.content: (The will fluctuation of the Heavenly Dao's Eye gradually calmed, its voice becoming meaningful) 'You want to save her?' After a pause, it continued: 'This One can give you a chance—become This One's new Agent, with the price of never leaving the Tianji Record for eternity.'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. In his heart, he rapidly calculated the pros and cons of this deal. The Heavenly Dao's Eye's proposal seemed tempting, but was riddled with traps—becoming an Agent meant becoming a new chess piece, and what he despised most was being manipulated by others.

But he also understood that with his current strength, he could not possibly confront the Heavenly Dao's Eye head-on. Although the Four-Dimensional Eye had broken through, his Heavenly Fate had already been consumed by more than half. If he forced another battle, he might not even have the strength to flee.

(A subtle curve appearing at the corner of his mouth, Chen Ji raised his head) Agent? Interesting. However, this junior has a habit—whatever the transaction, I must read the complete contract. Why doesn't the Senior lay out all the terms first?

In his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of praise: 'Good lad, learning to bargain with the Heavenly Dao. But be careful—the Heavenly Dao's Eye never makes unprofitable deals; every word from it may hide ulterior motives.'

Just then, Chen Ji's Four-Dimensional Eye once again captured a faint fluctuation—deep within the web of destiny, another force was quietly approaching. It was entirely different from the Heavenly Dao's Eye, darker, more chaotic, yet carrying a strange sense of familiarity.

dialogue.content: (Furrowing his brow slightly, Chen Ji calculated rapidly in his heart) Interesting... it seems this chess game is far more complicated than I imagined.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Dao's Eye proposed a deal, while Chen Ji discovered another mysterious force approaching. How to respond?

choices.description: Continue to engage the Heavenly Dao's Eye in a stalemate while secretly observing the movements of that mysterious force, seeking an opportunity to break the situation.

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately refuse, nor did he immediately agree. He merely smiled faintly, assuming an expression of careful consideration: 'The Senior's proposal... this junior needs time to think. After all, this is a matter concerning one's entire life.'

choices.description: While the Heavenly Eye is distracted, secretly investigate the source of that mysterious power. It may reveal new allies or threats.

text.content: Chen Ji continued to parry with the Heavenly Eye on the surface, but a strand of his spiritual sense quietly separated, probing toward that mysterious fluctuation. In the Four-Dimensional Eye, a blurry figure gradually became clear—was that... Ling Yuan's remnant soul?

choices.description: Directly refuse the Heavenly Eye's deal, showing that he will never be anyone's pawn. Display the unyielding spirit of one who would rather break than bend.
choices.risk_hint: Will face the Heavenly Eye's hostility

text.content: Chen Ji threw his head back in laughter, the sound echoing through the four-dimensional space: 'Your kindness, Senior, is appreciated. However—' His eyes suddenly turned cold, 'Chen will be no one's servant, not even Heaven.'

The Heavenly Eye's will fell silent for a moment. That transcendent dimensional existence seemed to be reassessing this 'ant' before it—having witnessed countless seers, some groveling, others treacherous, yet rarely had anyone dared to directly refuse its proposal.

dialogue.content: (A hint of amusement tinged that will's fluctuation) 'Interesting... You remind me of someone. The last person who dared speak to me like this died three thousand years ago.'

text.content: In the Four-Dimensional Eye, that mysterious fluctuation grew ever clearer. Chen Ji saw that face clearly—it was indeed Ling Yuan, or rather, a fragment of Ling Yuan's residual consciousness. Wrapped in some dark power, it hovered between the Heavenly Eye and Chen Ji, seemingly waiting for some opportune moment.

Alarm bells blared in Chen Ji's heart. He should have realized—after Ling Yuan was rejected by the Tianji Record, his soul did not completely dissipate, but was preserved by some force. Its appearance here is no coincidence.

Just then, the four-dimensional space violently trembled. Ling Yuan's remnant soul suddenly launched an attack, transforming into a beam of black light aimed directly at Chen Ji's spiritual core—it wanted to seize his body! The old sect master would never relinquish the Tianji Record's inheritance, even with only a wisp of soul remaining.

Chen Ji had long prepared. The Four-Dimensional Eyecrazed运转, the net of fate spreading before him into countless possibilities—he saw Ling Yuan's attack trajectory, saw countless ways to dodge, and also saw the most lethal point of impact.

dialogue.content: (Without moving, a cold smile curling his lips) Old thing, I haven't even come for you yet, yet you deliver yourself to my door. Convenient. Saves me the trouble.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment erupted with a thunderous crash, golden runes cascading forth like a flood. Chen Ji didn't choose to meet it head-on—in the instant Ling Yuan's remnant soul was about to touch him, his form flickered and he slipped into a four-dimensional rift. The next second, he had already appeared behind Ling Yuan.

Old thing, let me deliver a message from your disciple—Chen Ji's voice was cold as the deepest abyss, 'Some things are not for you to covet.' Before the words even finished, the Tianji Record Fragment had transformed into golden chains, ruthlessly binding Ling Yuan's remnant soul.
Ling Yuan let out a凄惨的哀嚎, that remnant soul thrashing violently under the golden chains. Yet his power was long gone; under the Tianji Record's suppression, his existence was visibly dissolving.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's remnant soul let out a despairing howl) 'Impossible... I was the Tianqing Sect's sect master... I was the Tianji Record's chosen inheritor... How could I lose to thistrash!'

text.content:
trash?

Chen Ji laughed, his laughter cold and mocking. He slowly walked toward that dissolving remnant soul, each step seeming to trample on Ling Yuan's dignity: 'Former Sect Master, you were indeed once a candidate for the Tianji Record. Unfortunately—' He leaned down, his voice barely a whisper, 'It chose me, not you. Accept your fate.'

Ling Yuan's remnant soul completely dissipated in despair. But in that final moment, a strange glint flickered in his eyes—that was some hidden contingency. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, the Four-Dimensional Eye spinning rapidly, trying to capture the meaning of that glint.

The image flickered, and Chen Ji saw a scene that chilled his heart—on the altar where Chen Nian resided, those countless rune chains were loosening. Ling Yuan's contingency at the moment of death had inadvertently disturbed the Heavenly Fate Altar seal.

Hope unlike any before surged in his heart. Within the Fourth-Dimensional Eye, Chen Nian's figure had become much clearer than before—her eyes were gazing toward some direction, her lips moving gently. Chen Ji deciphered her lip-reading: "Brother... I'm waiting for you."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions within him. He turned to face that eye of Heavenly Dao that had always been silently watching, his eyes glittering with unprecedented light: "Senior, the terms of the transaction... the junior wishes to discuss further."

The Fourth-Dimensional Space trembled slightly, the will fluctuations of the Heavenly Dao's Eye becoming unfathomable. It did not immediately respond to Chen Ji's words but cast its gaze toward the distant horizon—where the gears of destiny were accelerating their turn. Chen Ji knew that the true moment of choice was approaching.

When Ling Yuan's remnant soul completely dissipated, Chen Ji felt no joy whatsoever. What the Fourth-Dimensional Eye captured made his spine run cold—this was no ordinary loosening of a seal but some meticulously designed activation sequence. Beneath the altar where Chen Nian was imprisoned, a massive formation outline could be vaguely discerned, its scale far exceeding anyone's imagination.

"This formation..." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly grew grave, "This old man has seen this arrangement before. Three thousand years ago, on the eve of the ancient Heavenly Court's destruction, it was this same formation that buried the entire Heavenly Court into the Void."

dialogue.content: (His pupils contracting sharply, Chen Ji's voice low as an abyss) So... Nian Nian is not merely a Heavenly Fate Lock Key?

(Mo Xiansheng's voice carrying rare heaviness) "She is both sacrifice and key. The Heavenly Dao's Eye uses her to pry open the ancient seal, and once the formation fully activates—the entire cultivation world will be reshaped."

text.content: Chen Ji's fist slowly clenched tight, his knuckles turning white. Within the Fourth-Dimensional Eye, countless threads of destiny were intertwining madly—he saw the three great sects fall, saw the Demonic Path invade, saw the common people suffer. And the source of all tragedies pointed to the same coordinates: the Heavenly Fate Altar.
The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice rang out once more, this time carrying some indescribably profound meaning: "Now, do you still wish to negotiate terms with this one?"

Chen Ji raised his head, the Fourth-Dimensional Eye staring into that dimension-transcending will. After a moment of silence, he suddenly smiled—that smile held madness, determination, and even a ruthless resolve of one who would burn the boats: "Negotiate. Of course we negotiate."

He raised his hand, pointing toward that seal that was loosening: "However, the junior must first confirm one thing—does Senior's so-called transaction intend to use the junior to prevent this catastrophe, or does it wish to make the junior a new sacrifice?"

The Fourth-Dimensional Space fell into dead silence. The will fluctuations of the Heavenly Dao's Eye became exceptionally slow, as if deliberating every word. Finally, that dimension-transcending voice rang out: "Your value exceeds what this one had anticipated."

dialogue.content: (An unusual frankness actually surfacing within the Heavenly Dao's Eye's will) "This one can give you a choice—become the new master of the Tianji Record, replacing this one's position. But the price is... you must personally sacrifice your sister to the seal."

text.content: Chen Ji's smile froze. Within the Fourth-Dimensional Eye, countless scenes flashed madly—he saw himself become the new Heavenly Dao's Eye, ruling over the entire cultivation world in solitude; he saw Chen Nian transform into nourishment for the seal, her soul eternally dissipating into the Void. Both futures pointed to the same ending: he would lose her forever.
"Is there another path?" Chen Ji's voice terrifyingly calm, "The junior does not believe that between heaven and earth, only these two options exist."

The Heavenly Dao's Eye remained silent for a very long time. When it spoke again, exhaustion actually crept into its tone: "Over a thousand years... this one has seen countless prophets. Some chose obedience, some chose resistance, some attempted to take its place. But no one has ever asked—is there a third path?"
Chen Ji stared directly at that dimension-transcending existence, eyes burning with light never seen before: "That is because they did not possess the Fourth-Dimensional Eye. But I do."

The Fourth-Dimensional Eye operated madly, the web of fate infinitely extending before Chen Ji's eyes. He saw past, present, and future countless possibilities intertwining, like countless rivers converging into one sea. Among those intricate threads of destiny, he finally captured that faintly visible fourth possibility—a fusion of breaking free from shackles and replacing Heavenly Dao.
"I see it." Chen Ji's voice carrying irrepressible excitement, "The fourth possibility—neither obey nor replace, but fuse. What I must do is... coexist with Heavenly Dao."
